description: Create or change a permission set (admins only). Fields: name (required), description, deny_tools (patterns with *, e.g. 'analyze_*', '*invoice*'), finanzen ('sichtbar'|'einzeln'|'verborgen'), einzel_limit_stunde, hinweis. template='ohne_finanzen' fills a ready-made 'Projekte ohne Finanzen'. delete=true removes it (and its assignments).

delete.description: true deletes the set (with its assignments); needs id

deny_tools.description: Tool name patterns blocked by this set, * as wildcard (e.g. 'analyze_*')

einzel_limit_stunde.description: Hourly cap on single records with amounts that may be opened

finanzen.description: How amounts are shown: visible, only in a single record, or hidden

hinweis.description: Instruction text given to the AI for people with this set

id.description: ID of an existing permission set to change or delete; omit to create

template.description: Ready-made template to fill the set from ('Projekte ohne Finanzen')

name: set_permission_set
